lines.text: We install automatic sliding doors for supermarkets and retail centers.
Our platform offers instant push notifications to dispatchers on iOS and Android.
What is the timeline to have all four regional centers live on Brightpath?
We commit to standard go-live implementation within forty-five days.
Can we connect RFID door sensors directly into work order dispatches?
We could explore radio frequency sensor integrations in an enterprise roadmap review.
Understood. The forty-five day target works well for our schedule.
